90b8e4b988602558099b66a5ec8bfd4f4767f745.summary: Analysis of the rootkit component of Kinsing, a Golang-based Linux malware that targets misconfigured Docker Daemon API ports to drop cryptocurrency miners. Shell scripts install a backdoor, a miner and a rootkit, which uses library preloading to hook system functions and hide the malware's files, processes and TCP connections. The report says the threat actor reuses the public beurk rootkit with custom changes, and that Kinsing remains highly active and keeps evolving. Dated 24 November 2020.
